facts.title: Favorite Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 2 cans (15 ounces each) chickpeas, rinsed and drained, or 3 cups cooked chickpeas
1 ½ cups chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley (about 1 bunch)
½ cup chopped red onion (about ½ small)
3 tablespoons lemon juice (from 1 to 1 ½ lemons), or more if needed
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
